description: This file contains C++ code related to CUDA and cuDNN integration for quantized convolutions in the PyTorch library, including conditional compilation guards and template specializations for unpacking packed convolution weights.

classes.name: PackedConvWeightCudnn
classes.description: A templated class for handling the packing and unpacking of quantized convolution weights for cuDNN operations, specialized here for 2D convolutions.

methods.name: std::tuple<at::Tensor,std::optional<at::Tensor>> unpack()
methods.description: Returns the tensor representing the packed convolution weight and an optional bias tensor.
